subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Sort phrases into planet problems and ways to help.
Use verbs like save, switch off and plant with different objects.

tf.s: Global warming is a problem for our planet.
tf.why: Yes, global warming means the planet is getting hotter.

tf.s: Planting trees is one of our planet’s problems.
tf.why: Planting trees is a way to help the planet.

tf.s: Pollution is a problem for the environment.
tf.why: Right! Pollution makes air, water and land dirty.
Great! Recycling means using materials again.

tf.s: Wasting energy is a way to protect the planet.
tf.why: Wasting energy is a problem; we should save energy.

tf.s: Manar picked up rubbish from the beach.
tf.why: Yes, she picked up more than 30 pieces of rubbish.

tf.s: Eric destroyed a tree in the WOW! Blog.
tf.why: Eric planted a tree to help the environment.

tf.s: “Switch off the lights” means to turn the lights on.
tf.why: Switch off means turn off, so the lights stop using electricity.

tf.s: We can use the verb “save” with different objects, like water and energy.
tf.why: Correct! We say save water and save energy.

tf.s: Destroying the rainforests helps to stop climate change.
tf.why: Destroying the rainforests is a problem for our planet.

boxes.why: Destroy the rainforests is one of the planet’s problems.

boxes.q: Complete: People need to use ___ energy.
boxes.why: Renewable energy comes from sources that do not run out.

boxes.q: Please ___ the lights when you go out.
boxes.why: We switch off lights to save electricity.

boxes.q: Could you please ___ those bottles and put them in the bin?
boxes.why: We pick up rubbish and put it in the bin.

boxes.q: Which phrase is a way to help the planet?

boxes.why: Wasting energy is bad for the planet.

boxes.q: How did Eric help the environment?
Scientists think people’s activities are causing ___ warming.
A lot of people ___ energy by leaving on lights all the time.

boxes.why: We switch off the TV or the lights.

hunt.q: Manar picked up rubbish from the…

o: Turn off the lights so they stop using electricity

mcq.q: How did Manar help the environment?
o: She picked up more than 30 pieces of rubbish from the beach.

mcq.q: Which of these is a problem for our planet?
mcq.why: Climate change is one of the planet’s problems.

mcq.q: Which phrase means keeping nature safe?
mcq.why: To protect means to keep safe.

mcq.q: Put these in the right group: pollution, plant trees, waste energy, recycle. Which are problems?
mcq.why: Pollution and wasting energy hurt the planet.

mcq.q: Which sentence uses “save” with a different object from “water”?
o: We should save energy at school.
We should save water at home.
We should waste energy at school.
We should save the water tap.
mcq.why: Save energy uses a new object with the same verb.

mcq.q: Which sentence shows a way you can help the environment?
o: I leave the lights on all day.
I throw rubbish on the beach.
mcq.why: Recycling is a good way to help.

mcq.q: Is “global warming” a problem or a solution, and why?
o: A problem, because the planet is getting hotter
A solution, because it keeps us warm
A solution, because it saves energy
A problem, because it plants trees
mcq.why: Global warming is a problem: the planet is getting hotter.

mcq.q: Why is using renewable energy good for the planet?
o: It helps us stop wasting energy and causing pollution.
mcq.why: Renewable energy is one of the ways we can help.

mcq.q: Which pair is a problem and its matching solution?
mcq.why: Switching off lights stops wasting energy.
